CREATE TABLE `auditLogs` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `userId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `action` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `entityType` varchar(60) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `entityId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `oldValue` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `newValue` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  KEY `audit_entity_idx` (`entityType`,`entityId`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=750001

CREATE TABLE `awards` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `awardNumber` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `quotationId` int NOT NULL,
  `supplierId` int NOT NULL,
  `amount` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL,
  `reason` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `awardStatus` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `createdBy` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `awards_awardNumber_unique` (`awardNumber`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=60001

CREATE TABLE `certificates` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `certificateNumber` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `contractId` int NOT NULL,
  `currentValue` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `previousValue` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `deductions` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `netDue` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `certificateStatus` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `createdBy` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `certificates_certificateNumber_unique` (`certificateNumber`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=60001

CREATE TABLE `contractAmendments` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `contractId` int NOT NULL,
  `amendmentNumber` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `amendmentType` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `valueChange` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `extensionDays` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `reason` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `amendmentStatus` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `createdBy` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `contractAmendments_amendmentNumber_unique` (`amendmentNumber`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=60001

CREATE TABLE `contracts` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `contractNumber` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `supplierId` int NOT NULL,
  `contractType` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'supply',
  `startDate` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `endDate` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `originalValue` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL,
  `currentValue` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL,
  `currency` varchar(8) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SAR',
  `contractStatus` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `scope` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdBy` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `contracts_contractNumber_unique` (`contractNumber`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=240001

CREATE TABLE `deliveries` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `deliveryNumber` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `poId` int NOT NULL,
  `supplierId` int NOT NULL,
  `deliveredAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `deliveredValue` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `acceptedValue` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `rejectedValue` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `deliveryStatus` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'delivered',
  `reference` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdBy` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `deliveries_deliveryNumber_unique` (`deliveryNumber`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=240001

CREATE TABLE `documents` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `documentNumber` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `entityType` varchar(60) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `entityId` int NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `fileName` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `storageKey` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `url` varchar(700) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `mimeType` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `sizeBytes` int NOT NULL,
  `checksum` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `documentClassification` enum('normal','internal','confidential','highly_confidential') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'internal',
  `version` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `uploadedBy` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `documents_documentNumber_unique` (`documentNumber`),
  KEY `documents_entity_idx` (`entityType`,`entityId`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=60001

CREATE TABLE `financialOperations` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `operationNumber` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `supplierId` int NOT NULL,
  `contractId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `certificateId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `operationType` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `amount` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL,
  `currency` varchar(8) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SAR',
  `operationDate` datetime NOT NULL,
  `financialOperationStatus` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'recorded',
  `notes` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdBy` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `financialOperations_operationNumber_unique` (`operationNumber`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=60001

CREATE TABLE `integrationEvents` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `sourceSystem` varchar(80) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `destinationSystem` varchar(80) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `eventType` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `entityType` varchar(60) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `entityId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `correlationId` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `integrationStatus` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `attempts` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `lastError` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `nextRetryAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `completedAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `payloadMeta` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `integrationEvents_correlationId_unique` (`correlationId`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `notifications` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `notificationType` varchar(80) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `titleAr` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `titleEn` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `titleUr` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `messageAr` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `messageEn` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `messageUr` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `entityType` varchar(60) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `entityId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `readAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  KEY `notifications_user_idx` (`userId`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=60001

CREATE TABLE `permissions` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `code` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `module` varchar(60) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `action` varchar(60) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `labelAr` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `labelEn` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `labelUr` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `permissions_code_unique` (`code`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=1590001

CREATE TABLE `purchaseOrders` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `poNumber` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `supplierId` int NOT NULL,
  `contractId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `requestId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `totalAmount` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `currency` varchar(8) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SAR',
  `deliveryDate` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `deliveryLocation` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `poStatus` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `terms` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdBy` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `purchaseOrders_poNumber_unique` (`poNumber`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=240001

CREATE TABLE `purchasePackages` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `packageNumber` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `packageStatus` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `createdBy` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `purchasePackages_packageNumber_unique` (`packageNumber`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=60001

CREATE TABLE `purchaseRequestItems` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `requestId` int NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `quantity` decimal(14,3) NOT NULL,
  `unit` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `estimatedUnitPrice` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `specifications` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  KEY `request_items_request_idx` (`requestId`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=60001

CREATE TABLE `purchaseRequests` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `requestNumber` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `department` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `site` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `source` varchar(80) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'internal',
  `requestPriority` enum('low','normal','high','urgent') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal',
  `estimatedValue` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `currency` varchar(8) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SAR',
  `neededBy` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `requestStatus` enum('draft','submitted','approved','rejected','cancelled') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `notes` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdBy` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `budgetCode` varchar(80) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `budgetLimit` decimal(14,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `supplierId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `purchaseRequests_requestNumber_unique` (`requestNumber`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=540001

CREATE TABLE `quotations` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `rfqId` int NOT NULL,
  `supplierId` int NOT NULL,
  `totalAmount` decimal(14,2) NOT NULL,
  `currency` varchar(8) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SAR',
  `deliveryDays` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `paymentTerms` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `technicalCompliance` varchar(60) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `quotationStatus` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'received',
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=240001

CREATE TABLE `requestApprovals` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `requestId` int NOT NULL,
  `approvalAction` enum('submitted','approved','rejected','cancelled','revised') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `comment` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `actedBy` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  KEY `approvals_request_idx` (`requestId`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=60001

CREATE TABLE `rfqs` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `rfqNumber` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `closingAt` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `rfqStatus` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `createdBy` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `packageId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `rfqs_rfqNumber_unique` (`rfqNumber`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=240001

CREATE TABLE `sessions` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `tokenHash` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `expiresAt` datetime NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `sessions_tokenHash_unique` (`tokenHash`),
  KEY `sessions_user_idx` (`userId`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=750001

CREATE TABLE `suppliers` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `supplierNumber` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `nameAr` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `nameEn` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `nameUr` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `commercialRegistration` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `taxNumber` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(320) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(60) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `country` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `category` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `supplierStatus` enum('active','suspended','blocked') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `notes` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdBy` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `suppliers_supplierNumber_unique` (`supplierNumber`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=360001

CREATE TABLE `userPermissions` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `permissionId` int NOT NULL,
  `scopeType` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'global',
  `scopeValue` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `grantedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `user_permission_scope_unique` (`userId`,`permissionId`,`scopeType`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=660001

CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `openId` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `name` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(320) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `loginMethod` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT 'local',
  `role` enum('user','admin') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user',
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `lastSignedIn` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `username` varchar(80) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `passwordHash` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `preferredLocale` enum('ar','en','ur') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ar',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`) /*T![clustered_index] CLUSTERED */,
  UNIQUE KEY `users_openId_unique` (`openId`),
  UNIQUE KEY `users_username_unique` (`username`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AUTO_INCREMENT=660001
